role: fail-closed Blender+UAL pose-guide contact calibration; never visible character art

phase_semantics.contact_l: left sole descends through the fixed contact band while anatomical left leads
phase_semantics.down_l: left remains inside the fixed contact band at the following pelvis minimum
phase_semantics.passing_l: left remains inside the fixed contact band while right passes it in travel projection
phase_semantics.flight_l: after left toe-off, right leads and both soles exceed the flight band
phase_semantics.contact_r: right sole descends through the fixed contact band while anatomical right leads
phase_semantics.down_r: right remains inside the fixed contact band at the following pelvis minimum
phase_semantics.passing_r: right remains inside the fixed contact band while left passes it in travel projection
phase_semantics.flight_r: after right toe-off, left leads and both soles exceed the flight band

prohibitions: No generator IK target, socket table, declared contact flag, or motion-derived global minimum may define the floor.
No per-frame root translation may be applied to manufacture contact.
No Blender or VRM appearance may enter ImageGen source art, an atlas, HTML, or runtime output.
A missing distinct contact, down, passing, or flight event is HOLD; never duplicate or relabel another phase.
